This is a vertical product advertisement for a Midea rice cooker. At the top right, the white "Midea" logo with its circular emblem sits against a soft, blurred beige kitchen background. Below it, small white text reads "美的金刚布丁电饭煲 MB-RE336" (Midea Jingang Pudding Rice Cooker, model MB-RE336). The main headline uses large brush-calligraphy characters: "聚能" in white, "焖香釜" in bold orange, then a second line "三餐好滋味" in white, conveying a message about energy-concentrating cooking and good meals three times a day. Beneath this, a rounded pill-shaped banner lists three selling points separated by vertical bars: "聚能匠铜釜 | 6大菜单功能 | 3L黄金容量" (concentrated-energy copper pot | 6 major menu functions | 3L golden capacity).

The centerpiece is the rice cooker itself, placed on a white marble-patterned countertop. It has a glossy black lid and base, with a brushed rose-gold/pink metallic body band. The front control panel shows a digital display reading "0:40" in orange numerals, a row of small circular cooking-mode icons with food photos, and Chinese touch labels for keep-warm/cancel, reservation, function, and start. The Midea logo is repeated on the upper black band.

Surrounding props reinforce the food theme: to the left, a white plate holds a savory stew of cubed meat, potatoes, and greens; to the right, a white bowl is heaped with steamed white rice, with wooden chopsticks resting on a holder in front. Two halves of a fresh green fig with pinkish-red flesh lie in the foreground on the counter. The background is softly out of focus, showing a dark cabinet with round handles on the left and a framed picture on the right wall, creating a warm, modern home-kitchen atmosphere. No people or animated characters appear in the image.
